tamara.se: Heads-up 1 HelixMed just returned our RFI. They want a 10-day POC, capability matrix (hosted vs dedicated vs private), security questionnaire, and a short pricing memo for a 6-month pilot.

 mike.eng: What's the workload? seq len, concurrency, plus any PHI constraints?

 tamara.se: PHI + HIPAA, EU data residency. Usage: ~40 concurrent clinical users, typical prompt 250 tokens, bursts to 50 RPS, target p95 <350ms.

 olga.pricing: Noted. I'll model reserved baseline + overage and a token-based fallback. Need perf numbers to size GPUs.

 mike.eng: For those targets recommending Dedicated 2x A100s for 13B family; 70B pushes to H100. I'll run quick perf sweep today and post results.

 sec-bot: Uploaded: helixmed_security_q_v1.xlsx (https://drive.redwood/helixmed/sec_v1).

 sam.legal: Reminder: if EU PHI involved, we need DPA + SCCs. Also verify SOC2 scope for hosted.

 tamara.se: Can we support customer-managed HSM for keys? They require FIPS L3 or equivalent.

 sec-bot: HSM FAQ: https://drive.redwood/templates/hsm_faq.md 1 supports CloudHSM, Azure HSM, and on-prem PKCS#11. FIPS guidance included.

 mike.eng: I'll add runbook notes: airgap installer for Private, k8s requirements, ports, and a wrk script example. Also note prefix-KV caching can cut token usage ~20% for repetitive triage flows.

 olga.pricing: Great. I'll include cached vs uncached TCO and two scenarios (reserved GPUs vs token billing). Draft by EOD Thu.

 tamara.se: Action items: mike run perf + runbook, olga pricing draft, sam legal DPA + export notes. Quick sync Fri 9am to review. :calendar:

 olga.pricing: 9am works.

 mike.eng: I'll post perf numbers before sync and attach traces.

 end of thread
